module: Tracks the vehicle's damage during the career tutorial (and the time trial). It relies on gameplay_util_crashDetection to detect the end of a crash, waits for the vehicle to slow down (or a maximum delay), then displays an information window (career_modules_tutorialPopups) and a "repair" or "restart" task in the task list. The task disappears when the vehicle is repaired or reset.
notes: Wait before the window: up to 5 s (1.5 s in time trial) or as soon as the speed <= 3 km/h.
After going out of bounds (onCareerTutorialOutOfBoundsStarted), damage is ignored for 8 s.
Window identifiers: 'v2/damagedVehicleTimeTrial', 'v2/damagedVehicle' (tutorial active), 'v2/damagedVehicleCareer'; each is displayed only once per module session.
BUG: onVehicleResetted is defined twice; the second definition (simpler, without the time trial case) overwrites the first, so the first one's time trial handling is never executed.
The module only detects crashes for the tracked vehicle (trackedVehId); in time trial, it automatically tracks the player's vehicle.

setRepairGoal.desc: Sets the "repair" task displayed after a crash (task table for the task list). nil restores the default task.

goal.desc: Task table ({id, type, label, subtext, actionItems, done}).

setDefaultRepairGoal.desc: Restores the default repair task (id 'tutorial_repairVehicleGoal', action toggleRadialMenuMulti).

setDamagePopupHandler.desc: Replaces the opening of the career damage window with a custom handler, called with the window id. A non-function value removes the handler.

setTrackedVehicleId.desc: Sets the id of the vehicle to track (taken into account at the next ensureTrackedVehicle, for example in onUpdate).

vehicleId.desc: Vehicle id, nil to track nothing.

claimNextDamagePopup.desc: Marks a crash as already handled by the caller: the next damage window will be skipped, but the repair task will remain due.

showRepairTask.desc: Displays the repair task (or restart task in time trial) if tracking is active, a crash occurred and the vehicle has not been repaired yet.

setEnabled.desc: Enables or disables damage tracking. On disabling: stops tracking the vehicle and removes all tasks; on enabling: tracks the vehicle and displays the task if needed.

debugTriggerCrash.desc: Simulates a crash (debug): sets hadCrash and triggers the wait for the damage window.

cleanup.desc: Disables tracking and resets the whole module state (configured vehicle, task, handler, already-displayed window flags).

getHadCrash.desc: Indicates whether a crash has been detected since the last reset.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook: ensures the right vehicle is tracked, then, if a damage window is pending, displays it when the vehicle is almost stopped or after the maximum delay.

dtRaw.desc: Raw delta time (used for the wait delay).

onVehicleCrashEnded.desc: crashDetection hook called at the end of a crash. If the tracked vehicle is concerned (and damage is not suppressed), schedules the display of the damage window.

onCareerTutorialOutOfBoundsStarted.desc: Hook called when the player goes out of bounds: ignores damage for 8 s, cancels the pending crash and the repair task.

onCareerTutorialOutOfBoundsEnded.desc: Hook called when returning within bounds: outside time trial, if the tracked vehicle has damage, displays the repair task again.

onClientStartMission.desc: Mission start hook: ensures the tracked vehicle is up to date if tracking is active.

onRecoveryPromptRepairHereUsed.desc: Hook called when the player chooses to repair on the spot: marks the vehicle as repaired and removes the tasks.

onVehicleRepaired.desc: Hook called after a vehicle is repaired: if a crash had occurred, removes the repair tasks.

onRecoveryPromptButtonPressed.desc: Recovery window hook: if the 'restartMission' button is pressed in time trial after a crash, marks as repaired and removes the tasks.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is reset: if it is the tracked vehicle and tracking is active, marks as repaired and removes the tasks. (Effective definition: the file's second one, which overwrites the first.)
